n74224c3b18.headline: Tunisia: Inflation rate declined to 5.5 percent in September 2017 after an upward trend since the beginning of the year
n74224c3b18.summary: Tunisia's inflation rate for household consumption fell to 5.5% in September 2017, down from 5.7% earlier in the year.
n74224c3b18.why: Inflation trends affect Tunisia's monetary policy, consumer purchasing power, and economic stability.

n23236befa8.headline: Why is the tenge falling when oil prices are rising?
n23236befa8.summary: The Kazakhstani tenge has depreciated by 7% this quarter despite a 20% increase in oil prices, raising questions about its commodity currency status.
n23236befa8.why: Kazakhstan's economy is heavily reliant on oil exports; currency moves contrary to oil prices affect investor perceptions and FX markets.
n23236befa8.why_moved: The tenge's depreciation despite rising oil prices suggests other economic or policy pressures weakening the currency, impacting FX markets.
